issues.evidence: The title '自助机升级后，等待时间缩短' occupies only the upper area, while the lower half (y≈330–540) consists of one label and one short line, leaving large empty space; on the contact sheet this cover reads as mostly blank compared with the dense data pages.
issues.suggestedChange: Tighten vertical spacing or add a brief subtitle/key takeaway line near y≈250 to balance the composition without changing the wording.

issues.evidence: Page number '01 / 04' at x≈802,y≈501 uses color 465A72 on background F7F9FD, which is readable but low-emphasis relative to the 13px size.
issues.suggestedChange: Keep as-is or slightly darken the page-number color for improved legibility at small size.

issues.evidence: The chart area is x54–906, y143–479, but the data line only occupies y270–460; the top ~40% of the plot (y143–270) is empty, leaving the line visually stranded with no gridline or reference for the 0/negative range.
issues.suggestedChange: Either tighten the chart height/domain so the line fills the plot, or add a faint zero baseline/negative region since the brief requires preserving zero and negative values.

issues.evidence: The data labels 18 (x~270,y~305), 15 (x~615,y~375), 12 (x~925,y~435), and 9 (x~1255,y~490) sit directly above each point with no offset; the last label 9 (y~490) nearly touches the x-axis line at y~505.
issues.suggestedChange: Increase label-to-point offset or raise the plot so the final label 9 clears the axis.

issues.evidence: All four bars use identical fill 244F96, so the series for 预约图书自取区 (value 0) renders no bar; the zero data point is visually indistinguishable from a missing category.
issues.suggestedChange: Add a small zero-value marker or baseline dot at 0 for the 预约图书自取区 row so the zero datum remains visible, while keeping the negative values negative.

issues.evidence: Negative bar labels sit at the bar end (-3 at x≈385, -1 at x≈790) while positive labels sit outside the bar end (2 at x≈1405), producing inconsistent label placement across rows.
issues.suggestedChange: Place all value labels at a consistent offset beyond the bar tip on the outside of each bar, mirrored for negative direction.

issues.evidence: Chart value labels are specified with valueFontFace Segoe UI while body/title use Noto Sans CJK SC; digits render but the mixed font assignment is inconsistent with the surrounding CJK typography.
issues.suggestedChange: Align value label font with the deck typeface for visual consistency.

issues.evidence: The title text box (x:54–403, y:70–479) occupies nearly the entire left column, while the right-column content is pushed to y≈47 and starts at x≈425; the large 51px title becomes the dominant mark with no supporting visual on the left half.
issues.suggestedChange: Reduce the title frame height and size to free the lower-left area, or add a small supporting element (e.g., a key figure or icon) in that space so the left column does not read as an empty title plate.

issues.evidence: The labels “观察” and “下一步” sit at x=425 and the body text starts at x=593, leaving a consistent 168px gap; the body text lines wrap at different lengths (e.g., “跨馆借还比基线增加 2 分钟。” on one line vs. the two-line “逐笔核对跨馆记录…”), making the two rows visually uneven.
issues.suggestedChange: Align the two body blocks to a common measure and adjust copy so each body paragraph wraps at the same width, or indent text-0 to match text-1’s two-line block.

issues.evidence: The slide uses only two label/text pairs (观察, 下一步) plus a large title; the same label-left, body-right pattern repeats identically in both rows with no differentiated visual treatment for the conclusion vs. the action.
issues.suggestedChange: Differentiate the 下一步 row (e.g., bullet or accented background/stroke) so the conclusion and the action read as distinct blocks rather than two identical list rows.
